1143// SCSI status bytes
1144// (as per X3T9.2 revision 10 -- Table 27)
1145#define SCS_MASK 0x3e // Mask valid bits
1146#define SCS_GOOD 0x00 // Good
1147#define SCS_CHECK 0x02 // Check Condition
1148#define SCS_MET 0x04 // Condition Met/Good
1149#define SCS_BUSY 0x08 // Target/LUN is Busy
1150#define SCS_INTER 0x10 // Intermediate/Good (Obsolete)
1151#define SCS_INTERMET 0x14 // Intermediate/Condition Met/Good (Obsolete)
1152#define SCS_CONFLICT 0x18 // Reservation Conflict
1153#define SCS_TERM 0x21 // Command Terminated
1154#define SCS_QUEUEFULL 0x28 // Queue Full, Task Set Full
1155#define SCS_ACA_ACTIVE 0x30 // ACA Active
1156#define SCS_ABORTED 0x40 // Task Aborted
1157
1158// SCSI Message Description
1159// (as per X3T9.2 revision 10 -- Table 10)
1160// The first byte in the message determines the message format.
1161// One-Byte Message (COMMAND COMPLETE) 0x00
1162// Extended Message 0x01
1163// One-Byte Message 0x02 - 0x1F
1164// Two-Byte Message 0x20 - 0x2F
1165// Reserved 0x30 - 0x7F
1166// One-Byte Message (IDENTIFY) 0x80 - 0xFF
1167#define SCM_COMMAND_COMPLETE 0x00
1168#define SCM_EXTENDED_MSG 0x01
1169 #define SCM_MODIFY_DATA_POINTER 0x00
1170 #define SCM_SYNC_XFER_REQUEST 0x01
1171 #define SCM_EXTENDED_IDENTIFY 0x02
1172 #define SCM_WIDE_XFER_REQUEST 0x03
1173 #define SCM_WIDE_LEN 0x02
1174 #define SCM_SYNC_LEN 0x03

1334// Fixed Format Sense Data Structure
1335// Note: The field "error" has the following format:
1336// bit 7 - Address valid bit
1337// bits 6-4 - Error class
1338// bits 3-0 - Error code
1339//
1340// Error classes 0-6 are vendor unique and also indicate that the
1341// sense data is in _nonextended_ format. (i.e. not usually used)
1342// struct _scsi_nonextended_sense {
1343// uchar_t sd_err;
1344// uint32_t sd_block_address;
1345// };
1346//
1347// An error class of 7 and an error code of 0 (70H) indicate SCSI-1
1348// extended sense data format (or SCSI-2 sense data format).
1349//
1350// An error class of 7 and an error code of 1 (71H) indicate SCSI-2
1351// deferred errors.
1352//
1353// Error codes 74H to 7EH are reserved and error code 7FH indicates
1354// a vendor-specific sense data format.
1355typedef struct _scsi_sense {
1356 uchar_t error; // Error Code
1357 uchar_t segment; // Segment number
1358 uchar_t sense; // Sense key/flags
1359 uchar_t info[4]; // Information (32bit big-endian value)
1360 uchar_t asl; // Additional Sense Length
1361 uchar_t csinfo[4]; // Command-Specific Information
1362 uchar_t asc; // Additional Sense Code
1363 uchar_t ascq; // Additional Sense Code Qualifier
1364 uchar_t fruc; // Field Replaceable Unit Code
1365 uchar_t sks; // Sense Key Specific
1366 ushort_t sks_data; // Sense Key Specific Data (16bit big-endian)
1367 ushort_t asb; // Additional Sense uchar_ts (Max 256-18)
1368} SCSI_SENSE;
1369

1373typedef struct _scsi_sense_descriptor {
1374 uchar_t error; // Error Code
1375 uchar_t sense; // Sense key/flags
1376 uchar_t asc; // Additional Sense Code
1377 uchar_t ascq; // Additional Sense Code Qualifier
1378 uchar_t rsvd[3];
1379 uchar_t asl; // Additional Sense Length
1380} SCSI_SENSE_DESCRIPTOR;
